arguments.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE transparent Cartoon game sprite for GJFFFOOD.BMP frame 008.
Input 1 is the exact original pose/silhouette/eye-expression/fin and water-boundary authority, shown with a diagnostic pixel palette. Input 2 is ONLY the shared shark identity, gray material palette, pale underside, crisp black ink and clean cel-shading reference. Do not copy input 2's pose, grin or gaze when input 1 differs.
POSE: Preserve the strongly rolled, curled shark silhouette of reference 1 exactly: the head and very wide open toothy mouth are at LOWER LEFT pointing DOWN, the pale underside is exposed across the inside of the bend, the gray back arches across the TOP and the tail end bends down at the RIGHT with small attached pale splash/drip strokes. This is an inverted U arch, not a horizontal side-swimming shark. Retain the source's face orientation and eye visibility. The magenta/red diagnostic pixels mean warm pink mouth interior, not a checker pattern or blood. Do not rotate or unroll the body.
Render the original geometry as smooth, clean hand-drawn Cartoon art matching the shared key. Keep one shark only, no people, hands, props, extra tails or duplicated fins. Gray upper body, pale warm-gray/ivory underside, black outlines and restrained cel highlights. Any source-attached water must be white/pale-blue foam and light blue water, with no dark gray shadow, dark puddle or floor. No new water if the source has none. Actual RGBA alpha transparency throughout empty space, no checkerboard, background, atmospheric glow, text or border. Preserve the whole source silhouette and all included detached droplets; add comfortable transparent padding outside the drawing on every side. Do not use transparent padding to straighten or reorient the source pose.
